messages:
Maya (AE): Quick heads-up — Helix Health wants an "assurance packet" for the proof-of-concept. Ask list: SOC 2 excerpt (scope & effective date), ISO 27001 cert snapshot, a pen-test attestation letter we can sign, and a brief mapping showing which controls cover ePHI handling. Also they want to know cost difference if we run the POC on Hosted vs a short Dedicated reservation. Can we pull together a single ZIP?
Ravi (SE): I can grab the SOC 2 excerpt and write a one-paragraph summary of our relevant controls (auth, encryption-at-rest, logging/retention).
Priya (Security): Ill prepare a pen-test attestation template and a short note on what we can share vs what we redact. Need to confirm whether Helix expects a vendor-signed full report or just an attestation + exec summary.
Maya (AE): They asked explicitly for an attestation + exec summary only. No full redacted reports unless contracted.
Priya (Security): Good. I will include: (A) attestation (signed by Legal), (B) exec summary of the last external pen-test (date, scope, high/med findings and remediation status), (C) staging scan policy (48h notice, 3h window, POC contact).
Nora (Legal): I can sign the attestation as Head of Legal. If Helix sends any changes, route redlines to Legal for review; we should not accept operational commitments in the attestation.
Sam (SRE): Ill produce a sanitized network/dataflow diagram that avoids IPs or customer identifiers and a short hosting manifest (region, tenancy type, storage controls). For artifact delivery I'll generate a presigned S3 link with 7-day expiry. Example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/helix-poc-assurance.zip --expires-in 604800`
Ravi (SE): For pricing note: Hosted = no reservation, variable per-token; Dedicated = 2-week minimum reserved capacity for isolated POC (onboarding/slotting fee applies). Ill add a short table showing estimated cost on a small/medium/high usage profile.
Priya (Security): Clarifying: we segregate customer keys using KMS namespaces; production keys are never exported. Staging uses ephemeral credentials rotated per-session. Will add a short control statement about that.
Maya (AE): Helix wants everything in a single ZIP with a README that lists what is included and what we won't share (e.g., raw pen-test findings). Ill also confirm NDA status and whether they want the ZIP attached to the contract dataroom or sent over S3.
DeployBot: Ticket created: POC-12918 "Helix Health assurance packet" assigned to Priya, Ravi, Sam. Due date: 2026-01-15.
Nora (Legal): Ill pre-approve the attestation signer text now and sign the final doc once Priya drops it in the ticket.
Sam (SRE): Diagram + manifest ETA: tomorrow 11:30 PT. Ill attach the presign command and note the expiry in the README.
Ravi (SE): SOC 2 excerpt + pricing table ETA: tomorrow 14:00 PT.
Priya (Security): Draft attestation + exec summary ETA: tomorrow 10:00 PT. Will call out any limitations and include contact alias for scan scheduling.
Maya (AE): Great — target for the ZIP upload is 16:00 PT tomorrow. Ill follow up with Helix to confirm NDA and whether they need the artifacts in the contract dataroom. Please flag any blockers. :thumbsup:
Priya (Security): One more note: if they ask for penetration-test artifacts beyond the exec summary, route to Sales + Legal. We do not provide raw findings without an NDA + data-sharing agreement. Ill add that to the README.
Maya (AE): Noted. Thanks everyone.
